statement: This sketch creates an immersive deep space scene using p5.js in WEBGL mode. It depicts a boundless cosmic expanse with thousands of distant stars that twinkle and shimmer with subtle, randomized pulsing effects. The composition features wispy lanes of cosmic dust that drift slowly through the void, evolving and morphing as they move across the frame. The technique uses batched point rendering for stars and quad-based geometry for the dust lanes, creating a sense of infinite depth and perpetual celestial motion. The entire scene is purely observational, with no user interaction required—constantly shifting patterns emerge from simple mathematical functions that simulate the slow, elegant movement of matter through the cosmos.
